checks: Reproduced baseline: native Space cannot activate the focused silver button, while Enter can.
Locked skins are disabled and skipped by Tab; Space selects classic without starting a jump; Enter activates the historical return icon.
Keyboard Tab/Space/Enter changes unlocked selections with exactly one check mark; reopening retains gold; Escape restores the home page.
Real touch taps select silver/gold and activate the return icon; reopening keeps the selected state.
An actual touch swipe scrolls the compact panel without selecting; gold remains reachable and touch selection/return work.
Touch menu pause/resume still works after leaving the skin center.
